criteria.requirement: Implement icalendar.schedule_shift.shift_schedule(calendar, delta, *, mode="wall", ambiguous="error", shift_absolute_alarms=False). Return a deep copy shifting VEVENT/VTODO DTSTART/DTEND/DUE/RECURRENCE-ID, RDATE/EXDATE periods and RRULE UNTIL consistently across masters/overrides, preserving UID/text/duration and leaving timezone definitions/metadata unchanged. Explicit wall-vs-UTC semantics must handle DST gaps/ambiguity, floating times and integral-day DATE precision. Relative alarms stay relative; absolute triggers move only on opt-in. Invalid inputs must not alter original objects.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
